Apple 迎來 50 歲生日，不少客戶甚至比它更年長。Apple 近日新開咗一個支援專頁，列出 50 種令旗下裝置更易用嘅方法，主要都係透過輔助使用設定。

由調校 Apple Watch 上嘅字體大小，到設定 iPhone 喺洗衣機完成行程時通知你，應有盡有……

Apple 表示佢哋嘅目標係令科技人人適用，包括年長用戶。

At Apple, we believe the best technology should work for everyone, including older users. That's why our products and services are designed with built-in inclusivity, featuring accessibility functions that help you stay connected, be creative, and do what you love — in whatever way works best for you. As life changes, the way we interact with the world changes too. From enlarging onscreen text to making conversations clearer in noisy restaurants, Apple's ecosystem of devices, features, and services is designed to adapt to your needs.

The support page primarily lists accessibility features, organised into ten main categories.

  • Vision: View your screen comfortably
  • Hearing: Stay connected to conversation, alerts, and your surroundings
  • Mobility: Customise the way you control and navigate your device
  • Speech: Express yourself in your own way
  • Cognitive: Be present and in control
  • Personalisation: Make your experience your own
  • Organisation: Remember what's important
  • Health: Gain useful insights about your wellbeing
  • Safety: Put your mind at ease
  • Communication: Stay in touch

Taking the Vision category as an example, it includes features such as enlarging text, switching to bold text, inverting colours, applying colour filters, reducing transparency, increasing contrast, and reducing motion. Some features, like Sound Recognition, although heavily promoted by Apple at launch, remain not widely understood by the public.

Sound Recognition detects specific sounds and notifies you when they're detected using on-device intelligence. It can recognise 15 different sounds — you can also train your device to listen for your name, as well as distinctive electronic sounds in your environment, such as the beeps of kitchen appliances, specific types of alarms, or the ring of a doorbell. On HomePod, Sound Recognition can also detect the sound of smoke or carbon monoxide alarms. Sound Recognition also works with CarPlay. Your iPhone will detect sirens, horns, and even a baby crying. If you're using CarPlay, when specific sounds are detected, a notification will appear on your car's display.

This page comprehensively showcases the accessibility features currently available across Apple's devices, which is truly impressive. Each subcategory provides individual instructions for every supported device, and depending on the feature, coverage may include iPhone, iPad, Mac, Apple Watch, Apple TV, Vision Pro, and CarPlay.
